rows.en:
(Now, what are my plans this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite someone to go to
Central Park or something.)

Well, I was wondering if you'd want to go to
Central Park or something with me this weekend...

Central Park, huh... Not bad.
But I've got something going on this weekend.

Yeah, I was wondering if you'd want to go to
Central Park or something with me this weekend...

(Now, what are my plans this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite someone to go see
the Battle Frontier or something.)

Well, I was wondering if you'd want to go see
the Battle Frontier or something with me
this weekend...

The Battle Frontier, huh...
It's not like I'm not interested, but...
I'll pass this time.
(I guess the Battle Frontier was pushing it...)

Yeah, I was wondering if you'd want to go see
the Battle Frontier or something with me
this weekend...

(Okay, that's it for classes...
Maybe I'll ask Alto to stop off somewhere
with me on the way home...)

Hey, Alto. You wanna stop off somewhere
on the way home?

Hm, \p.
Yeah, that doesn't sound bad...
...Oh, wait.
Hm? What's up?

Ah, I've got something after this...
Sorry! Ask me again sometime, okay!
Okay. That's too bad, but it can't be helped.
(Well, I can always ask again.)

(Okay, that's it for classes...
Maybe I'll ask Saotome-kun to stop off
somewhere with me on the way home...)

Hey, Saotome-kun. You wanna stop off
somewhere on the way home?
Hm? What's wrong?
Okay. That's too bad, but it can't be helped.
(Well, I can always ask again.)

(Now, what are my plans this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite Alto to Griffith Park
and just take it easy...)

Yeah, I was wondering if you'd want to spend
the weekend with me at Griffith Park...

Griffith Park, huh? That might be nice.
...Oh, wait.

Ah, I just remembered I've got other plans
this weekend... Sorry! Ask me again
sometime, okay!

(Now, what are my plans this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite Saotome-kun to Griffith Park
and just take it easy...)

Hey, Saotome-kun. You wanna stop off
somewhere on the way home?

(Okay, that's it for classes...
Maybe I'll ask Saotome-kun to stop off
somewhere with me on the way home...)

Nyan-Nyan's food, huh... That sounds good.

(Now, what are my plans this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite Alto to go see
the Macross Quarter or something...)

Well, I was thinking, how about we go see
the Macross Quarter or something this weekend...

Wha-?! Why do I have to go to that place
even on my day off...
Nah, I'm joking, just joking...

Geez, that's taking a joke way too far.
At least let me relax on my days off...
Ahaha, fair enough.
(I guess the Macross Quarter was a no-go...)

(Now, what are my plans this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite Saotome-kun to go see
the Macross Quarter or something...)

Yeah, I was thinking, how about we go see
the Macross Quarter or something this weekend...
Um, I said I'm joking! Just joking...
Ufufu, fair enough.
(I guess the Macross Quarter was a no-go...)

(So, where should I go today?
I could head out somewhere far... Having tea
wouldn't be bad either~)
(Hmm, what should I do...)

\p-kun,
what's up? Why are you looking all around
like that out here?
Claire-senpai! Hello!

Mm, I like the energy.
So, what's up? You're looking around
like a tourist.

I was thinking of going somewhere, but...
I don't really know this city very well...
Hehe, so that's why you were looking around.
Hmm, what should I do...
What do you mean?
All right!!

Good old Claire-senpai here will show you
around her favorite spots!

You will, Claire-senpai?!
All right!!

Then let's go~!
Follow me!

(I followed her like she told me to,
but where are we?)

This is Silver Moon in San Francisco,
a cafe that's popular with students.
rows.notes: Silver Moon is provisional in the glossary; 'cafe' without the accent (Shift-JIS).

rows.en:
I hope you'll be able to bring a girl here
someday, too.

If you don't have anyone, I suppose I wouldn't
mind joining you for a cup of tea, you know?

Hehe!
Okay, on to the next spot.

(Hmm, no matter how I look at it, this is Deep
Akihabara... Claire-senpai sure gets around...)

This is Deep Akihabara,
a town where you can find just about anything.

but just in case.

Akihabara's near Shibuya, right?
And in Shibuya, if I remember right...
